  1. Requirements definition
  2. REQ-G60-US-DA-01

Adaptive cruise control as standard and simple assistance controls

Proposal
1, implement. Active cruise control (23 rows) and parking assistant (22 rows) complaints mention paying extra for functions expected as standard and awkward controls; the catalogue offers Driving Assistant Plus only as an option (1,000 EUR, 0 of 10 variants standard).
Horizon
H1. Hardware is fitted; standard content and HMI are a product decision.
Domain
Driver Assistance & Parking
Markets
US
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1

Statement

Adaptive cruise control shall be standard; following distance, lane keeping and assistance on/off shall be adjustable with one control while driving.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USVariants with adaptive cruise control as standardAllOffer checkevidence
USGap adjustment while drivingOne control on the steering wheelFunction testassumption
